name: Setu Iris

accent.usage: Primary actions, selection and brand artwork. Use the light value on light surfaces and the dark value on dark surfaces.

statusNote: Hex colours are familiar system-like fallbacks for static artwork. Use native dynamic NSColor values in the app; stopped follows secondaryLabelColor. These are not exact macOS colour specifications or text colours.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance using linearized sRGB; (Llighter + 0.05) / (Ldarker + 0.05), opaque solid colours.

checks.usage: Do not use; switch to dark accent
Do not use; switch to light accent

contrast.scope: These ratios apply to the solid colour pairs only, not glass gradients, translucent composites, semantic statuses or arbitrary system accent surfaces.
